Metadata.title: TUNES | Everyday Assistance & Companionship
Metadata.description: TUNES Alltagshilfe & Betreuung: household help, shopping and errands, accompaniment to appointments and personal companionship in everyday life. We speak German, Arabic, French and English.
Metadata.ogImageAlt: TUNES logo – a house with a heart – and the motto “Making everyday life easier, together.”

Hero.body: Whether it's housework, shopping or accompaniment to appointments: TUNES supports you personally and reliably – in a way that fits your daily life.

Services.title: How can we support you?
Services.intro: Practical help and personal companionship for your everyday life.

household.title: Household help
household.body: We help with cleaning, tidying, laundry and keeping things in order.
household.imageAlt: Two people on a sofa with a teapot and a basket of folded towels in a bright living room.

errands.title: Shopping & errands
errands.body: Support with grocery shopping, pharmacy errands and trips to the post office.
errands.imageAlt: An older woman and a helper unpacking a shopping bag with bread, apples and vegetables together in a kitchen.

accompaniment.title: Accompaniment
accompaniment.body: We accompany you to medical and other appointments and support you along the way.
accompaniment.imageAlt: An older woman walking arm in arm with a companion along the pavement of a quiet residential street.

companionship.title: Everyday assistance & companionship
companionship.body: Conversations, walks and support in everyday life – for families, children and young people too.
companionship.imageAlt: Two older men taking a walk together along an autumn path, one using a walking stick.

About.title: Personal support. Caring and close by.
About.body: You and your everyday life are at the centre of what we do. Together, we talk about the support you need and what matters most to you.

Process.title: Three steps to more relief in your day

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Send us an email describing what you need.

discuss.title: Discuss your needs
discuss.body: Together, we clarify your wishes and the right kind of support.

plan.title: Plan your support
plan.body: We agree on the next steps and appointments with you.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.intro: Answers to what you may want to know before getting in touch. Can't find your question? Feel free to write to us.

services.question: What services does TUNES offer?
services.answer: We help with housework, shopping and errands, accompany you to medical and other appointments, and offer everyday assistance and companionship – with conversations, walks and support in daily life, including for families, children and young people.

enquire.question: How can I request support?
enquire.answer: Send us an email at <email>betreuung@tunesalltagshilfe.de</email>. Briefly describe what you would like help with, and we will then discuss your needs together.

relatives.question: Can I request support for a relative?
relatives.answer: Yes. You can contact us for yourself or on behalf of a relative. We will discuss the support needed together with you.

languages.question: Which languages do you speak?
languages.answer: We speak German, Arabic, French and English. This website is available in German and English.

costs.question: How much does the support cost?
costs.answer: Please get in touch so that we can discuss your needs and the costs involved with you personally.

funding.question: Questions about cost coverage?
funding.answer: Talk to us about your situation and the support that may be available.

Contact.title: Let us make your everyday life easier.
Contact.body: Would you like support for yourself or a relative? We look forward to hearing from you.
